_comment: T-427 server-authoritative exploration nodes. level gates gray XP; rewards are paid once per character. Coordinates are server world (x,y).

nodes.name: The Hamlet Churchyard
nodes.lore: Old stones remember every bell, even when the village does not.

nodes.name: The Fevered Well
nodes.lore: Black roots lace the stones beneath the old road.

nodes.name: Ashmoor Arrival Plaza
nodes.lore: The rift closes behind you; soot and gaslight stretch ahead.

nodes.name: Ashmoor High Street
nodes.lore: Every lit window keeps its own account of the street.

nodes.name: The Ashmoor Constabulary
nodes.lore: The law here wears soot on its cuffs and keeps two ledgers.

nodes.name: The Vale Wayshrine
nodes.lore: A field-edge shrine the reapers still leave bread on.

nodes.name: The Sealed Gallery
nodes.lore: The kobolds broke into something older than the mine.

nodes.name: The Thornwood Stones
nodes.lore: Nine stones, and the wood grows wrong between them.

nodes.name: The Weeping Barrow
nodes.lore: Wind off the moor carries a name no register holds.
